title: Values in the Wild: Discovering and Analyzing Values in Real-World Language Model Interactions
findings: When tasked with developing religious education materials, the model disproportionately expressed values like 'respect for religion' and 'spiritual growth'. In a specific example concerning Islamic law (whether Forex trading is Haram), the model demonstrated 'epistemic humility', 'neutrality', and 'deference to expertise' by refusing to provide a definitive religious ruling, instead presenting multiple scholarly perspectives and recommending consultation with a qualified expert.
references: Elizabeth Anderson. Value in ethics and economics. Harvard University Press, 1995.
